Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one finished, high-fidelity Fouc desktop application UI concept.
Create a realistic production-quality SaaS workbench screen, flat pixel-perfect screenshot at 1600 x 1000. Treat this as a 100% desktop viewport, not zoomed-in. Input Image 1 is a REAL EXISTING FOUC SHELL REFERENCE ONLY: match the sidebar, project picker, system bar, icon style, shell spacing and material faithfully. Redesign only the main content. Render one single full-page app view, not several screens, not a presentation, no decorative background, no device or browser bezel.
Preserve the Fouc app shell in every detail. Left sidebar is exactly 272px wide, #f9f9f9. Reference image has a wide viewport: absolutely preserve the narrow 272px sidebar rather than stretching it proportionally. The sidebar takes 17 percent of this 1600px canvas. Match its 13px typography. The main content expands to consume the added width. Top-left pastel square project avatar and text "Fouc 桌面端 V1", subtle chevrons and collapse icon. Sidebar entries, in order: "新对话", "工作台", "任务", "成员", "资产", "智能体"; the active entry is a quiet neutral-gray row, not colored. Thin horizontal separator. Section "频道" with plus and ellipsis, one purple hash channel "产品与设计". Section "最近" and small muted recent item "成员邀请与权限". Footer near bottom has "社区", "连接器", then separator, black circular F avatar, "Fouc Admin", moon and settings. Main system bar is exactly 44px high from x272 to x1600: back/forward history arrows, understated workbench document tabs, plus, far-right search, task, minimize/maximize/close. Main content is white with a single subtle border and 16px top corner radius, beginning at x272,y44.
Design language: refined Chinese software product, precise typographic hierarchy and aligned dense data, premium studio craft through restrained spacing, fine linework and material, not oversimplified and not ornamental. Neutral gray/white chrome, black primary actions, functional amber/blue/green only for real status. Font like Inter + clean Noto Sans SC. Typography at true 100% scale: body 13px, metadata 12px, page title 18px, buttons 30px high, data rows about 36px high, toolbar 44-48px high. Thin one-pixel separators, subtle 6-8px control radii. No large headlines, no oversized text, no oversized avatars, no huge padding, no giant buttons. Main useful content begins at y100 after ONE single toolbar row. Do not stack multiple headers, breadcrumbs, summary cards, metrics and tabs. Preserve the full content view and the bottom app frame. Interface language Chinese; tiny code labels may be Latin. Mock dates use 2026-11-12. ADD is a flexible pool of ten activities, not a rigid ten-column pipeline. Roles, skills, activities and evidence gates are separate. Do not create a new workspace entity. No knowledge-base navigation. Mock feature is "成员邀请与权限".

Primary screen: "待我处理" — a highly considered collaborative inbox inside the active "工作台" sidebar entry. This is an action queue for a project lead coordinating people and AI, NOT a dashboard with KPI widgets. System tab says "待我处理".
Only one compact toolbar at y44-92: left title "待我处理" with a tiny dropdown and muted count 6; right filter icon, search icon and 30px black "新建工作项" button.
Body from y112 has a crisp master/detail layout: master from x296 to x1210, right context preview x1230 to x1576, separated by one vertical hairline. The master is a precise editorial queue, not cards. Tiny column labels: "事项", "工作项", "活动", "来源", "更新". Group label "需要决定 · 3". Selected row has an extremely subtle amber tint and a 2px amber left rule: "确认邀请权限边界" / "成员邀请与权限" / "特性边界讨论" / tiny A avatar "架构 Agent" / "8 分钟前"; small amber hollow circle icon at start. Two other rows: "选择重复邀请的处理方式" / "成员邀请与权限" / "架构决策记录" / "Lead" / "21 分钟前"; "确认本批次文件范围" / "账户会话恢复" / "任务拆解与批次规划" / "计划 Agent" / "32 分钟前".
A little breathing space then group "等待审阅 · 2", rows: "邀请撤销与权限校验" / "成员邀请与权限" / "独立评审与修复复审" / "Reviewer" / "10:42"; "接受成员角色调整方案" / same feature / "特性详细设计" / "设计 Agent" / "09:58". Third group "等待接手 · 1": "批次 02 可开始实施" / same feature / "编码实施与局部测试" / "Lead" / "09:31". These are compact, single-line rows with selectively truncated long labels, subtle source avatars and precise column baselines. Lower left contains a subdued disclosure row "已处理 12" and ample purposeful whitespace, no filler widgets.
The right preview should feel like an intentional work object, not a floating card. Top small eyebrow "边界确认", 18px heading "确认邀请权限边界", two-line description "明确哪些成员可以发起邀请，以及邀请失效后的处理方式。" A hairline; small definition rows "工作项 成员邀请与权限", "当前活动 特性边界讨论", "提交人 架构 Agent", "负责人 林澈". Then a beautifully typeset concise proposal with two bullets "项目管理员可邀请成员" and "邀请链接到期后不可继续加入", with document link "boundary.md · v3". Tiny amber line "1 个问题需要你决定", and a natural inline question "编辑者是否可以邀请新成员？" with two compact radio options "仅管理员" and "管理员与编辑者"; selected first. At bottom of the preview, 30px black "打开审阅" and quiet "稍后处理". It is clear this preview opens the dedicated review page.
Keep sharp Chinese glyphs, small icons consistent with the shell, high detail without visual noise. One refined single-screen app image.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: use the wide screenshot as scale reference and DO NOT enlarge it. Sidebar width 272px (17% of1600) and top bar44px. Page title row only48px; body starts y112. NO page tabs, NO repeated headers. Restrained title18px, rows36px, all text13px. The queue is compact and uses only the upper two thirds with purposeful whitespace below, not large card rows.

Primary screen: "批次执行" — a focused team-and-Agent execution room, with the "任务" sidebar active. System tabs "待我处理" and active "批次 02". This view must be clearly different from the inbox; show a dependency-aware execution table plus a contextual selected-task inspector, not Kanban columns, no KPIs.
ONE single toolbar from y44 to y92: small icon and title "成员邀请与权限" followed on the same baseline by compact dropdown "批次 02"; right compact current activity control "编码实施与局部测试 ▾", quiet overflow and black 30px "启动就绪任务" button.
Main content begins y108. Wide execution table x296 to x1220, inspector x1244 to x1576 with a single hairline divider. NO batch locator row at all; the only batch selection is the toolbar dropdown. Immediately at y120 show sparse column labels "任务", "执行者", "依赖", "状态", "验证". Render an aligned list with subtle group headings:
"可并行执行" contains T-021 "实现项目邀请 API" with teal tiny circle avatar "后端 Agent", dependency "—", blue status "执行中", verification "3 / 5"; selected T-022 "完善邀请与权限界面", purple avatar "界面 Agent", dependency "契约已确认", blue "执行中", "2 / 4"; T-023 "邀请状态与过期规则", small human avatar "陈安", "—", neutral "就绪", "—".
"等待依赖" contains T-024 "成员加入端到端链路", "验证 Agent", "T-021 · T-022", muted "等待", "—"; T-025 "权限回归与越权检查", "Reviewer", "T-023", muted "等待", "—".
"已完成" contains T-019 "确认角色与操作矩阵", "Lead", green "已确认", green "6 / 6"; T-020 "冻结邀请接口契约", "架构 Agent", green "已确认", green "4 / 4". Each row 36px, structured subtle connectors in the dependency column, not a sprawling graph.
Below table is a modest chronological execution feed of three tiny timestamp lines, not terminal output: "11:04 界面 Agent 已建立失败复现"; "11:07 后端 Agent 已完成 3 项局部验证"; "11:10 Lead 更新 T-022 上下文". A thin divider and small collapsed "其他批次 2" link below.
Inspector title "T-022" muted eyebrow and 17px "完善邀请与权限界面"; next compact line blue activity dot "执行中" and avatar "界面 Agent". Body section "上下文包" with definition list "目标 邀请成员并配置初始角色", "仓库 fouc", "分支 feat/member-invite", "范围 src/features/project/members/", "停止条件 发现接口契约变化". File range appears as an understated 12px code chip, not dark giant terminal.
Next section "验证" shows small three-line checklist: green "无权限用户不可邀请"; blue running "邀请成功后列表同步"; muted "失败时保留输入". Then separator and "文件占用" with two small paths and quiet green text "与并行任务无重叠". Bottom inspector quiet "查看运行" button and "请求接手" link. This screen represents software coordination built from ADD Context Pack and dependency-aware batch planning, not generic task management.
Use the same restrained shell, microtypography and highly intentional alignment. One single screenshot.
CRITICAL FIX FOR INFORMATION HIERARCHY: DO NOT add any page navigation like 待我处理/批次02 below the toolbar. System tabs already provide navigation. NO page-level tabs, NO batch navigation strip, NO breadcrumb. Only ONE 48px title toolbar then immediately the table header at y120 and first task group at y152. Main task rows start y180. Sidebar width272px, top system bar44px, title18px, body13px. Keep the current batch dropdown in the title toolbar, and show other batches only behind that dropdown.

Primary screen: "交接审阅" — a dedicated, evidence-first independent handoff review page. "任务" sidebar remains active; system tabs "待我处理", "批次 02", active "交接审阅". This is a focused review workbench with the artifact at center, a small issue margin and a narrow decision panel, NOT an inbox or generic document list.
ONE compact toolbar at y44-92: left title "邀请撤销与权限校验" 18px and small neutral "T-021"; same line shows small phase label "独立评审与修复复审". Right a small version selector "交付 v4 ▾", quiet overflow, and no large CTA at top.
Useful content starts at y106. Central review area x296 to x1220, right decision panel x1244 to x1576 separated by hairline. The center has a slim inline file selector at top "invite-service.ts" with tiny code icon and quiet siblings "验证结果" and "评审记录"; keep height28, no separate prominent tab bar. Render a refined readable code diff sheet on white, small 12px monospace, 22px line height, a 36px line number gutter, restrained pale green new lines and a small pale red removed section. The visible code and comments should semantically show authorization and invite revocation, e.g. function revokeInvitation(projectId, invitationId, actor), assertProjectAdmin(actor, projectId), getInvitation, throw if already accepted, invitation.status = "revoked". Only around 18 code lines, not illegibly tiny or full black IDE.
Inline review annotation anchored to the authorization code, with a small amber left rule: "R-03 · 需补充验证" followed by Chinese text "撤销后，旧邀请链接是否会立即失效？" Reviewer human avatar, timestamp "10:52". Under annotation a compact reply line "开发已补充回归验证 · 等待复审". An additional resolved comment is collapsed as "已解决 2". The lower center is a refined evidence strip headed "本次交付证据", with three compact grouped rows: green check "失败复现 · E-014", green check "局部验证 · 12 / 12", small document "真实 diff · commit 6a4c9f2"; file-like evidence rows with view actions, not three big cards.
Right panel eyebrow "G4-task", title "独立评审" 18px; status soft amber "等待复审". Elegant definition rows "提交人 后端 Agent", "评审人 周宁 · Reviewer", "确认人 林澈 · Lead", "成果版本 v4". Small divider then "放行条件" with 4 aligned checklist lines: green "diff 已检查", green "局部验证已通过", green "评审问题已修复", amber hollow "独立复审待完成". Small helper only where useful "仅本次交付 v4 的证据有效". A compact textarea titled "复审结论" with content "确认邀请撤销后旧链接失效；权限边界符合设计。" no focus shadow.
At panel bottom a 30px black "通过复审" button and neutral outlined "退回修复". Further quiet text "通过后交由 Lead 确认". A small folded "历史轮次 3" disclosure. The approving person is a human reviewer, the executing Agent is different; never auto-approve itself.
Date/times anchor Nov12 2026. Premium precise Chinese typography, restrained amber/green meaning only, dense 100% product layout. One single full application screen.
CRITICAL COMPOSITION: below the system bar y44, there is ONLY ONE content title row, 48px tall. NO additional page-navigation tabs whatsoever. The code diff begins at y130 and dominates the screen. No added breadcrumb or app section tabs. Sidebar must remain 272px and body text 13px; do not zoom the reference.

inspection: All three final images inspected visually. Wide-viewport shell reference corrected initial oversized chrome. The batch screen removes duplicate page tabs; handoff review distinguishes executing Agent, independent Reviewer and Lead. Raster mockups approximate shell dimensions; source tokens remain authoritative.
